Package org.apache.beam.runners.flink.translation.functions

Class HashingFlinkCombineRunner<K,InputT,AccumT,OutputT,W extends BoundedWindow>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.runners.flink.translation.functions.AbstractFlinkCombineRunner<K,InputT,AccumT,OutputT,W>
org.apache.beam.runners.flink.translation.functions.HashingFlinkCombineRunner<K,InputT,AccumT,OutputT,W>
public class HashingFlinkCombineRunner<K,InputT,AccumT,OutputT,W extends BoundedWindow> extends AbstractFlinkCombineRunner<K,InputT,AccumT,OutputT,W>
A Flink combine runner that builds a map of merged windows and produces output after seeing all input. This is similar to whatReduceFnRunner does.
